title: C Position: Left Hand (C B A G F)
description: The mirror image of the right-hand position: left thumb on middle C, fingers 2-5 on B, A, G and F below it, reading the notes in the bass clef.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Stepwise and small-skip patterns within F3-C4 with fingers 1-5 on every note; the right hand rests so you can watch the left hand alone.
teachingPoints: Left thumb on middle C, little finger on F: the pattern C-B-A-G-F goes DOWN the keyboard as the fingers go 1-2-3-4-5.
Middle C sits on the line just above the bass staff - learn that one note first and read the others by step from it.
Bar 3 has skips (C-A, B-G): feel the gap with the hand still, do not reach.
Bar 6: three Fs with finger 5 - the weakest finger, so keep the wrist relaxed and let arm weight help.
